entities.name: FtsW (B6ELH6)
observations: Exact sequence match to reviewed Aliivibrio salmonicida FtsW; 400 aa, 100% identity and coverage (query_protein).
Annotated as an essential cell-division peptidoglycan polymerase, EC 2.4.99.28; inner-membrane multipass protein localized to the division septum (query_protein).

entities.name: RHEA:23708
observations: FtsW catalyzes addition of lipid-linked disaccharide-pentapeptide peptidoglycan precursor to a growing glycan chain, releasing undecaprenyl diphosphate and H+; reaction annotated EC 2.4.99.28 (query_protein).

entities.name: Peptidoglycan biosynthesis
observations: The exact-sequence FtsW reference is annotated in peptidoglycan biosynthesis and cell-wall biogenesis (query_protein).

entities.name: Resveratrol
observations: Explicitly identified in the accessible article title/abstract; also described as 3,5,4′-trihydroxy-trans stilbene, a synonym rather than a separate entity.

entities.name: Hydrogen peroxide
